data.long_meaning: The name Guilbert is derived from the Old German words 'wil' meaning 'will' and 'berht' meaning 'bright'. It was originally given to warriors who were known for their bravery and bright, shining qualities. The name Guilbert carries the meaning “Brave warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Guilbert usually hope their child will grow to embody brave warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Γκιλμπέρ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γκιλμπέρ προέρχεται από τις Γερμανικές λέξεις 'γκιλ' και 'μπρεχτ', που σημαίνει ισχυρή ματιά και υποσχόμενες βραχίονες. Το όνομα χρησιμοποιείται συχνά σε Χριστιανικές κοινότητες και αντανακλά αίσθηση δύναμης και ασφάλειας.
